title: The Gaudin model and the super Bethe ansatz for unitarizable modules over the general linear Lie (super)algebra
summary: Let $\mathcal{A}^{\bf z}_{\mathfrak{g}}$ be the Gaudin algebra for the general linear Lie (super)algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ with respect to a sequence ${\bf z} \in \mathbb{C}^\ell$ of pairwise distinct complex numbers, and let $\mathbb{L}$ be any $\ell$-fold tensor product of (infinite-dimensional) unitarizable highest weight $\mathfrak{g}$-modules. Fix a singular weight $ξ$ of $\mathbb{L}$.
